main.description: Lists published vocabulary tags by optional publisher DIDs with stable cursor pagination; authentication is not required.

authors.description: Publisher repository DIDs; values are ORed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor; keep direction and filters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter value, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: VocabTagQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed tags or required publisher lookups could not be queried; retry after checking the HappyView PostgreSQL service.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when pagination is complete.
